title: Input and Formatted Output
learning_objectives: You can format console output cleanly using f-strings
You can read user input and convert string data to integers

prerequisites_check.question: What is the key principle behind Input and Formatted Output?
prerequisites_check.explanation: Python requires adhering to clear lexical and semantic rules.

explanation_simple: f-strings allow you to insert variables directly inside a sentence by placing curly brackets around their names.
explanation_technical: F-strings (formatted string literals) are evaluated at runtime by opcode BUILD_STRING, providing fast formatting without str.format() overhead.
